faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before installing PVR.

items.q: Can customers upload photos to WooCommerce reviews?
items.a: Yes. PVR Media Reviews adds a photo and video upload field directly to the WooCommerce review form, so customers can attach real photos and videos of the product to their review with no extra setup required.

items.q: Does this plugin slow down my site?
items.a: No. All video compression happens in the visitor's browser before upload, so your server never processes raw video files. There is no FFmpeg dependency and no extra CPU load, so you don't need to upgrade hosting to support video reviews.

items.q: Can this plugin help my store get more organic search traffic?
items.a: Yes, with the Pro version. The All Reviews page lets shoppers filter reviews by category, rating, and helpfulness, and each filtered view gets its own auto-generated SEO title and meta description based on a template you configure. This turns every product category into its own indexable landing page built entirely from your customers' reviews.

items.q: Does this plugin replace WooCommerce reviews?
items.a: No. The plugin extends native WooCommerce reviews stored as WordPress comments. All reviews remain fully compatible with WooCommerce and can be migrated at any time.
Videos are compressed entirely in the browser using the MediaRecorder API and Canvas. No server-side processing is required. The compressed video is then uploaded to your WordPress media library.
The plugin supports MP4 and WebM formats. Compression output depends on browser support — Chrome/Edge produce WebM, Safari produces MP4.
Yes. The Pro version adds custom criteria ratings, email reminders, review coupons, analytics, carousel/grid layouts, and an SEO-friendly All Reviews page for the whole store.

items.q: What are the requirements to install PVR?
items.a: WordPress 6.0 or later, WooCommerce 7.0 or later, and PHP 7.1 or higher.

items.q: Can I start with the free version and upgrade later?
items.a: Yes. You can start with the free version and upgrade to PVR Pro whenever you need additional features. Your existing reviews and settings remain available.

items.q: What does the $59 Pro license include?
items.a: The $59 license is a one-time payment for use on a single WooCommerce site. You get a lifetime Pro license with every Pro feature — SEO Review Pages, custom criteria ratings, email reminders, review coupons, analytics dashboard, and carousel/grid layouts — plus updates and support. No renewals, no hidden fees.
No. It is a one-time payment. As a founding customer you keep your license — with updates and support — forever.

Not for founding customers. The first 100 Pro licenses are lifetime: one payment, with updates and support included forever. After those are sold, PVR Pro will move to an annual subscription for new customers.

items.q: What happens after the first 100 licenses are sold?
items.a: Nothing changes if you already own a license — it stays lifetime forever. New customers will join through an annual subscription. Buying now locks in lifetime access for your site.

items.q: How many sites can I use Pro on?
items.a: One Pro license is for one website.

meta.title: All Features & Settings — PVR Media Reviews
meta.description: Complete guide to every feature and setting in PVR Media Reviews — the WooCommerce photo and video review plugin.

features.body:
Every Feature & Setting

A complete guide to every feature in PVR Media Reviews — from photo and video reviews to voting, replies, and schema markup.

Free Plugin

Core Features

Everything included in the free PVR Media Reviews plugin — available for free on the WordPress repository.

Photo Reviews

Customers upload real product photos directly in the review form. Multiple photos per review. Thumbnails with lightbox preview on the product page.

Flexible Review Form

Pros & Cons fields, optional phone and city, privacy-policy consent, and an avatar uploader with a built-in crop tool — every field is configurable.

Video Reviews

Customers record or upload videos. MP4 and WebM formats supported. Videos play inline in a modal — no page reloads, no external links.

Client-Side Video Compression

Large videos are compressed in the browser before upload using MediaRecorder API + Canvas. No FFmpeg, no server CPU load. Configurable compression threshold and quality.

Helpful Voting

Visitors can mark reviews as "helpful". The most helpful reviews rise to the top, helping potential buyers make decisions faster.

Store Replies

Store owners can reply to any review directly from the WordPress admin. Replies are displayed publicly below the review.

Media Gallery & Viewer

Two-level media experience: a grid of all product media and a detailed viewer showing large photos and videos next to the full review — with a custom in-modal video player.

Reviewer Avatars

Each reviewer can upload a profile photo. Avatars appear next to their reviews, adding visual trust and personalization.

Verified Purchase Badge

Reviews are automatically checked against WooCommerce orders. Real buyers get a Verified Purchase badge on their review cards.

Schema Markup

Automatic JSON-LD structured data for product reviews. Helps Google display star ratings and review snippets in search results.

Email Notifications

Automatic email to store owner when a new review is submitted. Configurable in WooCommerce email settings.

Reviewer Accounts

My Account → Avatar (upload with crop) and My Reviews — the customer's own reviews with moderation statuses and media.

Video Thumbnails

Automatic thumbnail generation from video first frame. Displayed in the gallery grid before the user clicks to play.

Photo Watermarks

Automatic watermarks on review photos: pick the image, position, and width. Applied before the photo ever reaches the server.

Honeypot & Anti-Spam

Built-in invisible honeypot field protection and per-IP rate limiting to block automated bot submissions without frustrating human buyers. Optional Google reCAPTCHA v3 support.

Granular Permissions

Choose who can review, reply, and vote: everyone, registered users, or verified buyers. Auto-approve modes per role and a one-review-per-product limit.

7 Languages Out of the Box

Fully localized with bundled translation JSON files for English, Spanish, French, German, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Russian.

Powerful Review Admin

Purpose-built review admin: filters by status, product, and media; bulk actions; a full review editor with a media lightbox; import photos from the WordPress media library; coupon block (Pro).

PHP Upload Limits Wizard

Detects your server type and safely raises upload_max_filesize for large videos — with config backups, verification, and automatic rollback.

Self-Update, Backups & Import/Export

One-click updates with integrity checks and pre-update backups, settings import/export, and database schema sync.

Pro Features

Advanced Tools

Everything in Free, plus SEO review pages, analytics, marketing automation, and flexible display widgets.

SEO Review Pages

A dedicated, filterable all-reviews page for your store. Each category filter gets its own auto-generated SEO title, meta description, and URL slug. Manual SEO landing pages for any filter combination — category, manufacturer, or both — with custom H1, meta tags, HTML description, and snippets.

Custom Criteria Ratings

Define custom rating criteria per product or globally — Quality, Value, Durability, etc. Each criterion gets its own rating bar and average score. Multilingual criteria titles (WPML/Polylang), per-category binding, and a summary block above the review list.

Email Reminders

Automatically send follow-up emails asking customers to leave a review after purchase. Configurable delay, subject line, and email template. Two reminder emails with placeholders, queue statistics, and one-click unsubscribe.

Coupons for Reviews

Automatically generate discount coupons when a customer leaves a review. Configure discount type (percentage or fixed), amount, and coupon validity period. Separate amounts for text, photo, and video reviews, plus a reward banner above the review list.

Analytics Dashboard

Track review submissions, average ratings, and media uploads over time. Visual charts showing trends and review volume growth. Top-10 products, products needing attention, daily trends, and coupon statistics.

Carousel & Grid Widgets

Display reviews anywhere — product pages, homepage, landing pages — as a swipeable carousel or responsive grid. Use shortcodes or PHP functions. Five configurable breakpoints, autoplay with inertia swipe, and media-only filtering.

Technical Details

Requirements, compatibility, and technical specifications.

Video Compression Browser-side via MediaRecorder API + Canvas. No FFmpeg required. No server-side processing.
Database Extends native WooCommerce reviews (WordPress comments). All reviews fully compatible with WooCommerce.
File Storage Media stored in WordPress uploads directory. Standard WordPress media management.

Performance Conditional asset loading, WebP variants for photos, client-side compression, and widget query caching keep pages fast.
Data Ownership Reviews are native WordPress comments. Deactivating or deleting the plugin never deletes your reviews, media, or settings.

settings.body:
All Plugin Settings

Complete reference of every configuration option in the PVR Media Reviews admin panel, organized by settings tab.

General Settings

Free Auto-approve Reviews Select which reviews should be published automatically without moderation. Options: Disabled (manual moderation for all), From customers (auto-approve reviews from buyers of the product), From registered users (auto-approve from logged-in users), From all users (auto-approve everything).
Free One Review per Product Limit each user to one review per product. When enabled, a customer who already left a review cannot submit another one for the same product. Default: enabled.
Free Who Can Review Control who is allowed to leave reviews. Options: All visitors (anyone, including guests), Registered users (only logged-in users), Only customers (only users who purchased the product).
Free Who Can Reply Control who can reply to reviews. Same options as above: All visitors, Registered users, or Only customers.
Free Who Can Vote Control who can mark reviews as "helpful". Options: All visitors, Registered users, or Only customers.
Free Default Reply Status Default moderation status for store replies. Options: Enabled (auto-approved, shown immediately) or Disabled (held for moderation before publishing).
Free Pros & Cons Enable separate "Pros" and "Cons" fields in the review form, allowing customers to list specific advantages and disadvantages of the product. Default: enabled.
Free Phone Field Show an optional phone number field in the review form. Default: disabled.
Free City Field Show an optional city field in the review form, letting reviewers share their location. Default: disabled.
Free Privacy Policy URL URL to your privacy policy page. When set, a consent checkbox linking to this URL is shown in the review form.

Limits & Anti-spam

Free Review Min Length Minimum number of characters required for a review. Prevents empty or very short reviews. Default: 10.
Free Review Max Length Maximum number of characters allowed in a review. Default: 5000.
Free Name Min Length Minimum number of characters for the reviewer's name. Default: 3.
Free Name Max Length Maximum number of characters for the reviewer's name. Default: 64.
Free Reply Min Length Minimum number of characters required for a reply to a review. Default: 10.
Free Reply Max Length Maximum number of characters allowed in a reply. Default: 2000.
Free Pros/Cons Max Length Maximum number of characters for each Pros and Cons field. Default: 500.

Security

Free Reviews / Day (per IP) Maximum number of reviews a single IP address can submit per day. Prevents spam from repeat visitors. Default: 10.
Free Users / Day (per user) Maximum number of reviews a single registered user can submit per day. Default: 20.
Free Media Files / Day Maximum number of media files (photos + videos) a single IP can upload per day. Default: 12.
Free Media Weight (MB) / Day Total weight limit (in MB) of all media files a single IP can upload per day. Prevents storage abuse. Default: 1500 MB.
Free Hidden Field Protection (Honeypot) Enable a hidden form field that bots automatically fill in, allowing the system to detect and reject automated spam submissions. Default: enabled.
Free Enable reCAPTCHA v3 Add Google reCAPTCHA v3 verification to the review form for advanced bot protection. Default: disabled.
Free reCAPTCHA Site Key Your Google reCAPTCHA v3 site key. Required when reCAPTCHA is enabled.
Free reCAPTCHA Secret Key Your Google reCAPTCHA v3 secret key. Required when reCAPTCHA is enabled.
Free reCAPTCHA Threshold Minimum score (0.0–1.0) required to pass reCAPTCHA verification. Lower values are more lenient. Default: 0.5.
Free Allowed Photo MIME Types Comma-separated list of allowed photo file extensions. Default: jpg, jpeg, png, webp.
Free Allowed Video MIME Types Comma-separated list of allowed video file extensions. Default: mp4, webm, mov.

Media — Image Settings

Free Target Resolution Maximum image resolution after server-side processing. Images larger than this are resized. Options: HD (1280×720), Full HD (1920×1080), QHD (2560×1440), 4K UHD (3840×2160). Default: Full HD.
Free Global Quality JPEG/WebP compression quality (40–100). Higher values preserve more detail but increase file size. Default: 85.
Free Max Photos per Review Maximum number of photos a customer can attach to a single review. Default: 5.
Free Photo Size Min (MB) Minimum file size for photo uploads. Files smaller than this are rejected. Default: 0.1 MB.
Free Photo Size Max (MB) Maximum file size for photo uploads. Files larger than this are rejected. Default: 8 MB.
Free Watermark Image Upload a watermark image to automatically overlay on all user-submitted photos. Leave empty to disable.
Free Watermark Position Position of the watermark overlay on photos. Options: Disabled, Top-left, Top-right, Bottom-left, Bottom-right, Center.
Free Watermark Width (%) Watermark width as a percentage of the image width. Default: 20%.
Free Max Avatar Size (MB) Maximum file size for avatar uploads. Default: 5 MB.
Free Avatar Target Size (px) Avatars larger than this (in pixels) are automatically resized on upload. Default: 500 px.

Media — Video Settings

Free Target Resolution Maximum video resolution after client-side compression. Options: HD (1280×720), Full HD (1920×1080), QHD (2560×1440), 4K UHD (3840×2160). Default: HD.
Free Target Bitrate Target video bitrate for compression. Higher bitrates produce better quality but larger files. Options: 2500 kbps (HD), 5000 kbps (Full HD), 8000 kbps (QHD), 16000 kbps (4K UHD). Default: 5000 kbps.
Free Max FPS Maximum frames per second for compressed videos. Videos with higher FPS are downsampled. Default: 30.
Free Compress Above (MB) Videos larger than this size (in MB) are automatically compressed in the browser before upload using modern MediaRecorder API + Canvas. Zero server CPU load. Default: 50 MB.
Free Max Videos per Review Maximum number of videos a customer can attach to a single review. Default: 3.
Free Video Size Min (MB) Minimum file size for video uploads. Default: 0.1 MB.
Free Video Size Max (MB) Maximum file size for video uploads before compression. Default: 500 MB (fully configurable).
Free Video Duration Min (sec) Minimum video duration in seconds. Shorter videos are rejected. Default: 3 sec.
Free Video Duration Max (sec) Maximum video duration in seconds. Longer videos are rejected. Default: 120 sec.

Media — Thumbnail Settings

Free Grid Thumbnail Width Width in pixels of thumbnails shown in the gallery grid on the product page. Default: 100 px.
Free Grid Thumbnail Height Height in pixels of thumbnails in the gallery grid. Default: 100 px.
Free Modal Preview Width Width in pixels of the image preview shown in the detail modal. Default: 400 px.
Free Modal Preview Height Height in pixels of the image preview in the detail modal. Default: 400 px.
Free Lightbox Image Max Width Maximum width in pixels of images displayed in the full-screen lightbox. Default: 1920 px.
Free Lightbox Image Max Height Maximum height in pixels of images in the lightbox. Default: 1080 px.
Free Grid Thumbnail Quality Compression quality (40–100) for grid thumbnails. Default: 100.
Free Modal Preview Quality Compression quality (40–100) for modal preview images. Default: 100.
Free Lightbox Quality Compression quality (40–100) for full-screen lightbox images. Default: 90.

Emails & Notifications

Free Store Logo Logo displayed in email headers. Leave empty to use your site's custom logo.
Free Store Name Store name shown in email headers and footers. Leave empty to use your WordPress site name.
Free Store Phone Phone number displayed in emails. Leave empty to use the WooCommerce store phone.
Free Contact Email Contact email address shown in the email footer.
Free Admin Email Email address that receives new review notifications. Default: WordPress admin email.
Free From Name Sender name in email headers. Default: your WordPress site name.
Free From Address Sender email address in email headers. Default: admin email.
Free Confirmation Email Subject Subject line for the confirmation email sent to customers after review submission.
Free Notify Admin on New Review Send an email notification to the admin when a new review is submitted. Default: enabled.
Free Confirmation to Customer Send a confirmation email to the customer after their review is submitted. Default: enabled.
Free Notify Customer on Reply Send an email to the customer when the store replies to their review. Default: enabled.

Coupon Rewards PRO

Pro Enable Coupon Rewards Automatically issue a unique WooCommerce coupon code to customers after their review is approved/published.
Pro Discount Type Type of discount for generated coupons. Options: Percentage discount, Fixed cart discount.
Pro Reward Amount — Text Review Discount amount given for a text-only review (no media). Default: 5.
Pro Reward Amount — Photo Review Discount amount given when the review includes photos. Default: 10.
Pro Reward Amount — Video Review Discount amount given when the review includes videos. Default: 15.
Pro Coupon Validity (days) Number of days the generated coupon remains valid after issuance. Default: 30.
Pro Minimum Order Amount Minimum cart total required to use the coupon. Default: 0 (no minimum).
Pro Exclude Sale Items Prevent the coupon from being applied to products already on sale.
Pro Products (IDs) Comma-separated list of product IDs the coupon can be used on. Leave empty for all products.
Pro Exclude Products (IDs) Comma-separated list of product IDs the coupon cannot be used on.
Pro Categories (IDs) Comma-separated list of category IDs the coupon can be used on.
Pro Exclude Categories (IDs) Comma-separated list of category IDs the coupon cannot be used on.
Pro Email Subject Subject line for the coupon reward email. Supports placeholders: {customer_name}, {coupon_code}, {coupon_amount}, {expiry_days}, {site_name}, {shop_url}.
Pro Email Message Body text of the coupon reward email. Supports the same placeholders as the subject line.
Pro Show Notice on Review Form Display a notice on the review form informing customers about the coupon reward. Default: enabled.
Pro Notice Text Custom text for the coupon notice on the review form. Supports placeholders: {text_amount}, {photo_amount}, {video_amount}, {max_amount}.
Pro Minimum Characters for Text Reviews Minimum character count for text-only reviews to qualify for a coupon reward. Prevents very short reviews from getting rewards. Default: 50.

Email Reminders PRO

Pro Enabled Send automatic review request emails to customers after their order is completed.
Pro Delay (Days) Number of days to wait after order status changes to "Completed" before sending the first reminder. Range: 1–90. Default: 7.
Pro Repeat Reminder Send a second reminder email if the customer still hasn't left a review after the first one.
Pro Repeat Delay (Days) Days after order completion to send the second reminder. Range: 2–180. Default: 14.
Pro Exclude Categories Comma-separated list of product category IDs to exclude from reminders.
Pro First Reminder — Subject Subject line for the first reminder email. Supports placeholders: {site_name}, {customer_name}, {order_number}.
Pro First Reminder — Heading Email heading displayed at the top of the first reminder.
Pro First Reminder — Message Body text of the first reminder email. Supports the same placeholders as the subject line.
Pro Second Reminder — Subject Subject line for the second reminder email. Same placeholder support.
Pro Second Reminder — Heading Email heading for the second reminder.
Pro Second Reminder — Message Body text of the second reminder email.

Widgets — Carousel PRO

Pro Review Count Number of reviews to display in the carousel. Range: 1–50. Default: 10.
Pro Product Filter reviews by product ID. Set to 0 to show reviews from all products. Default: 0 (all).
Pro Category Filter reviews by category ID. Set to 0 to show all categories. Default: 0 (all).
Pro Show Only Reviews with Media Only display reviews that contain photos or videos. Default: disabled.
Pro Order By Sort order for carousel reviews. Options: Date, Rating, Helpful votes. Default: Date.
Pro Autoplay Automatically cycle through slides. Default: enabled.
Pro Slide Delay (ms) Time in milliseconds between autoplay slides. Range: 1000–15000. Default: 5000.
Pro Pagination Type Navigation indicator style. Options: Scrollbar, Dots. Default: Scrollbar.
Pro Inertia Power How far the carousel slides on a swipe/flick gesture. Range: 0–10, step 0.5. Default: 3.
Pro Max Inertia Slides Maximum number of slides per inertial flick. Range: 1–30. Default: 10.
Pro Avatar Size (px) Size of reviewer avatars in the carousel. Range: 20–200. Default: 70.
Pro Product Image Size (px) Size of the product thumbnail in carousel cards. Range: 20–500. Default: 48.
Pro Media Thumbnail Size (px) Size of photo/video thumbnails in carousel cards. Range: 40–400. Default: 120.

Responsive Breakpoints

Pro Desktop (≥1200px) — Slides Number of visible slides on desktop. Default: 4.
Pro Desktop — Navigation Arrows Show prev/next arrows on desktop. Default: enabled.
Pro Desktop — Pagination Show pagination on desktop. Default: enabled.
Pro Tablet Large (992–1199px) — Slides Number of visible slides on large tablets. Default: 3.
Pro Tablet Large — Navigation / Pagination Toggle navigation arrows and pagination for large tablets. Defaults: enabled.
Pro Tablet (768–991px) — Slides Number of visible slides on tablets. Default: 2.
Pro Tablet — Navigation / Pagination Toggle navigation arrows and pagination for tablets. Defaults: enabled.
Pro Mobile Landscape (480–767px) — Slides Number of visible slides in mobile landscape. Default: 2.
Pro Mobile Landscape — Navigation / Pagination Toggle navigation arrows and pagination for mobile landscape. Defaults: enabled.
Pro Mobile (<480px) — Slides Number of visible slides on small mobile screens. Default: 1.
Pro Mobile — Navigation / Pagination Toggle navigation arrows and pagination for mobile. Defaults: enabled.

Widgets — Grid PRO

Pro Review Count Number of reviews to display in the grid. Range: 1–50. Default: 6.
Pro Product Filter reviews by product ID. Set to 0 for all products. Default: 0.
Pro Category Filter reviews by category ID. Set to 0 for all categories. Default: 0.
Pro Show Only Reviews with Media Only display reviews that contain photos or videos. Default: enabled.
Pro Order By Sort order for grid reviews. Options: Date, Rating, Helpful votes. Default: Date.
Pro Avatar Size (px) Size of reviewer avatars in grid cards. Range: 20–200. Default: 70.
Pro Product Image Size (px) Size of product thumbnail in grid cards. Range: 20–500. Default: 48.
Pro Media Thumbnail Size (px) Size of photo/video thumbnails in grid cards. Range: 40–400. Default: 120.

Responsive Columns

Pro Desktop (≥1200px) — Columns Number of grid columns on desktop. Default: 3.
Pro Tablet Large (992–1199px) — Columns Number of grid columns on large tablets. Default: 3.
Pro Tablet (768–991px) — Columns Number of grid columns on tablets. Default: 2.
Pro Mobile Landscape (480–767px) — Columns Number of grid columns in mobile landscape. Default: 2.
Pro Mobile (<480px) — Columns Number of grid columns on small mobile screens. Default: 1.

Reviews Page PRO

Pro Page Title (HTML title) The HTML <title> tag for the all-reviews page. Used by search engines. Default: "Customer Reviews".
Pro H1 Heading The main H1 heading displayed at the top of the reviews page. Default: "All Customer Reviews".
Pro Description Introductory text shown below the heading on the reviews page.
Pro Reviews per Page Number of reviews loaded per page. Range: 1–100. Default: 12.
Pro Show Pagination Display numbered pagination below the reviews. Default: enabled.
Pro Show "Show More" Button Display a "Show more" button to load additional reviews. Default: enabled.
Pro SEO Title Template (Category Filter) Auto-generated <title> for filtered category views. Variables: %category%, %count%. Default: "%category% Reviews".
Pro H1 Template (Category Filter) H1 heading for filtered category views. Same variables. Default: "%category% Reviews".
Pro Description Template (Category Filter) Description for filtered category views. Default: "Read %count% customer reviews about %category% products."

Analytics PRO

Pro Dashboard Read-only analytics dashboard showing review submissions over time, average ratings, media upload statistics, and review volume trends. No configuration required — data is collected automatically.
